text:
Alyssa Chen: Heads up — kickoff for an "SI Academy" plan. Need input on curriculum + cert levels. Thinking: Fundamentals (onboarding), Advanced Integration, Marketplace Ops, Hardware Validation. When can we align?

Mike Patel: Nice. Include a trainer kit + recorded labs. Weekly 60m sessions over 4 weeks? Plus a hands-on cert exam. :white_check_mark:

Jordan Rios: Agree on levels. Proposal: Bronze = course completion, Silver = hands-on lab signoff, Gold = customer-ready + lab signoff + joint demo.

Sophia Li: Do we have lab infra for the hands-on labs? We should give each SI an isolated sandbox. @Ram can you confirm infra availability and rough cost?

Ram Gupta: We can spin ephemeral VPCs in staging. If we include GPU instances for quantization tests, estimate ~ $2k per cohort for infra. Will need finance ok for pilot.

Alyssa Chen: Pilot target = 3 SIs, start in June. Budget ask ~ $6k. Also we need a marketplace enablement checklist (docs, listing metadata, partner descriptor). @Jordan can you draft the marketplace + validation checklist?

Jordan Rios: Will draft. Rough checklist items: onboarding doc, integration test harness, verified model variants, usage quotas, listing metadata, co-marketing assets, hardware compatibility tests. Sharing draft link when ready.

Sophia Li: For co-marketing/joint announcement, coordinate with PR. Recommend waiting until first Gold cert is complete so we have a success story.

Mike Patel: Trainer playbook snapshot:```
Session 1: Overview + API quickstart
Session 2: Dedicated & Private deployment patterns
Session 3: Integration lab (marketplace + SI flow)
Session 4: Hardware validation & troubleshooting
Exam: 30-min practical (deploy + smoke test)
```

partner-bot: Reminder: Add course to LMS and schedule instructor slots by 2026-05-12.

Ram Gupta: I'll run a cost breakdown and post numbers by EOD tomorrow. Also will list required SKUs for the lab (GPU types + storage).

Alyssa Chen: :thumbsup: I'll assemble a one-pager for Sales and Solutions to share with potential SIs. Can someone volunteer to be primary trainer? @Mike?

Mike Patel: Happy to lead first cohort and author the lab exercises.

Jordan Rios: Draft checklist link (internal): https://redwood-internal/si-academy/checklist — will update today.

Sophia Li: Proposed timeline: Draft materials by 2026-04-25, pilot signups open 2026-05-01, cohort start 2026-06-01.

Alyssa Chen: Perfect. I'll capture action items in Notion and ping owners. Thanks all!
